injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday. He remains out for Friday's contest against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell
injuries.comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

injuries.name: Dailyn Swain
injuries.comment: Swain (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.comment: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Meleek Thomas
injuries.comment: Thomas (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.comment: Aldama (knee) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Alpha Diallo
injuries.comment: Diallo (personal/wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Phoenix, Vic Lombardi of Altitude Sports reports.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.comment: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.comment: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Reed Sheppard
injuries.comment: Houston picked up Sheppard's (back) fourth-year team option Friday, per Lachard Binkley of SI.com.

injuries.name: Alperen Sengun
injuries.comment: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mavericks, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Obi Toppin
injuries.comment: Toppin (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Miami.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is practicing in the G League at Noblesville Boom training camp, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ivica Zubac
injuries.comment: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.comment: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.comment: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.comment: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Ziaire Williams
injuries.comment: Williams has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left foot injury management, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.comment: Pippen (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Ty Jerome
injuries.comment: Jerome (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Quinten Post
injuries.comment: Post (ankle) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.comment: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

injuries.name: Jordan Poole
injuries.comment: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Jose Alvarado
injuries.comment: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Alex Caruso
injuries.comment: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.comment: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.comment: Embiid (rest) closed Friday's 98-93 victory over the Knicks with 10 points (3-12 FG, 0-4 3Pt, 4-4 FT), seven rebounds, seven assists, one block and one steal in 33 minutes.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.comment: James (rest) closed with 20 points (8-15 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 2-3 FT), nine rebounds, eight assists, one block and one steal across 34 minutes during Friday's 98-93 win over the Knicks.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.comment: Brown (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Jabari Walker
injuries.comment: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.

injuries.name: Tacko Fall
injuries.comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Robert Williams III
injuries.comment: Williams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Jazz.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.comment: Youngblood (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against Utah.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.comment: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.comment: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.comment: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.comment: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.comment: Markkanen (wrist) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
